profile.name: Upadhyay Viraj S.
profile.title: Software Engineer
profile.heroBio: A versatile Software Engineer focused on crafting high-performance web applications, intelligent Python automation systems, and applied AI/ML models that solve real-world problems.
profile.aboutBio: I am a Software Engineer based in Gujarat, currently pursuing my B.Tech in Information Technology at JG University following a diploma from Government Polytechnic, Rajkot. My engineering journey bridges modern full-stack web development with intelligent data systems and machine learning algorithms. I thrive on translating complex logic into intuitive, efficient, and resilient software.

services.description: Architecting responsive, high-speed web platforms with modern JavaScript, Node.js, and clean component-driven architecture.

services.title: Python Scripting & Automation
services.description: Engineering robust background scrapers, automated file pipelines, and data processing utilities that save hours of manual labor.

services.title: Applied AI & Computer Vision
services.description: Deploying intelligent predictive models, NLP sentiment classifiers, and real-time object detection systems using OpenCV and modern ML frameworks.

services.title: Database & API Design

education.description: Specializing in advanced software engineering, distributed systems, machine learning architectures, and cloud computing principles.
Established deep foundational mastery in object-oriented programming, data structures, relational database management, and computer networking.

projects.title: DevTask
projects.subtitle: Task Management System
projects.tagline: A collaborative workflow platform with interactive Kanban boards and real-time tracking.
projects.description: DevTask is a modern productivity application built to organize engineering workflows. Features dynamic drag-and-drop task boards, priority tagging, sprint estimation, and status analytics with persistent local state.
projects.problem: Teams and individuals frequently struggle with cluttered workflows and convoluted project tracking interfaces that distract from actual execution.
projects.solution: Constructed an ultra-responsive, zero-latency task board utilizing custom event handling, intuitive state management, and real-time progress indicators.

projects.title: SpendWise
projects.subtitle: Personal Expense Tracker
projects.tagline: Financial tracker with automated budget insights and interactive expenditure graphs.
projects.description: SpendWise enables individuals to record, categorize, and inspect their spending habits through visual charts, monthly balance alerts, and CSV export capabilities.
projects.problem: Lack of visual financial clarity leads to uncontrolled expenditure and fragmented budget tracking.
projects.solution: Built an interactive financial dashboard providing instant income-versus-expense calculations and real-time dynamic breakdown charts.

projects.title: ChatSphere
projects.subtitle: Real-Time Chat Application
projects.tagline: Instant bi-directional communication room with live presence and typing notifications.
projects.description: ChatSphere is a real-time messaging platform supporting topic channels, user presence indicators, instant message delivery via WebSockets, and clean message rendering.
projects.problem: Traditional HTTP-based chat applications suffer from latency and poor polling overhead.
projects.solution: Implemented persistent bi-directional communication channels with low overhead, enabling instantaneous typing indicators and reliable delivery.

projects.title: ShopEase
projects.subtitle: E-Commerce Platform
projects.tagline: Modular online storefront with real-time cart computation and catalog filtering.
projects.description: A comprehensive e-commerce front-end application with dynamic product search, price filters, responsive shopping cart drawer, and order summary computation.
projects.problem: Complex e-commerce checkouts often suffer from slow client-side rendering and clunky cart updates.
projects.solution: Designed a lightweight, reactive cart state model that instantly updates balances, applies coupon logic, and persists cart items across sessions.

projects.title: FileFlow
projects.subtitle: Automated File Organizer
projects.tagline: Intelligent file system daemon that classifies, renames, and archives directory clutter.
projects.description: FileFlow runs as an automated background utility to sort messy folders (Downloads, Desktop, Documents) by MIME type, creation date, and file extension into structured directory trees.
projects.problem: Manual desktop and download folder cleanup is tedious, repetitive, and time-consuming.
projects.solution: Engineered a Python automation script using OS and Watchdog events that instantly intercepts new files and routes them into categorized destination archives.

projects.title: PDFMaster
projects.subtitle: PDF Management System
projects.tagline: Comprehensive document utility for batch merging, splitting, watermarking, and encryption.
projects.description: PDFMaster is an all-in-one document pipeline providing automated PDF operations including password protection, page extraction, watermark stamping, and file compression.
projects.problem: Online third-party PDF converters often compromise sensitive data privacy and enforce strict file size limits.
projects.solution: Crafted an offline, privacy-first local Python utility that securely handles high-volume document transformations without sending bytes over the wire.

projects.title: WebScraper Pro
projects.subtitle: Web Data Extraction Tool
projects.tagline: Concurrent scraping engine with rate limiting, proxy handling, and multi-format export.
projects.description: An enterprise-grade web scraping pipeline engineered to parse nested HTML pages, bypass client rendering, and export structured data directly to CSV, JSON, and SQLite.
projects.problem: Manual data extraction from dynamic sites is prone to anti-scraping blocks, inconsistent schemas, and performance bottlenecks.
projects.solution: Implemented an asynchronous scraping engine featuring intelligent user-agent rotation, retry backoff logic, and robust schema validation.

projects.title: StockTrack
projects.subtitle: Stock Market Data Analyzer
projects.tagline: Financial analytics tool calculating technical indicators and visual price trends.
projects.description: StockTrack queries market feeds to generate historical price charts, calculate Moving Averages (SMA/EMA), Relative Strength Index (RSI), and detect breakout patterns.
projects.problem: Retail investors often face information overload and pay heavy subscription fees for simple technical indicator computations.
projects.solution: Developed a streamlined Python analytical script that pulls ticker data and generates clean visual trendlines and indicator signals.

projects.title: SentimentAI
projects.subtitle: Sentiment Analysis System
projects.tagline: Natural language processing model classifying customer reviews and sentiment polarities.
projects.description: SentimentAI uses advanced text preprocessing, tokenization, and vectorization to analyze user feedback, classifying sentiments into Positive, Neutral, or Negative with high confidence scores.
projects.problem: Organizations receive thousands of customer reviews and support tickets daily without a practical way to prioritize negative alerts.
projects.solution: Built an end-to-end NLP classification pipeline that ingests raw feedback, strips noise, and scores emotional polarity in milliseconds.

projects.title: MovieMind
projects.subtitle: Movie Recommendation System
projects.tagline: Hybrid recommendation engine combining content-based filtering with cosine similarity.
projects.description: MovieMind recommends tailored cinema selections by processing plot descriptions, cast attributes, and genre tags through high-dimensional vector spaces.
projects.problem: Users spend excessive time browsing streaming libraries without discovering relevant media tailored to their taste.
projects.solution: Designed a content-based recommendation model utilizing feature extraction and Cosine Similarity matrices to deliver instant recommendations.

projects.title: FraudGuard
projects.subtitle: Fraud Detection System
projects.tagline: Anomaly detection engine identifying high-risk transactional anomalies with ML models.
projects.description: FraudGuard inspects transaction parameters (velocity, amount, location deviation) and applies trained ensemble classifiers to flag fraudulent actions in real-time.
projects.problem: Imbalanced transaction datasets make typical models prone to excessive false negatives on financial fraud.
projects.solution: Trained Random Forest and XGBoost classifiers with SMOTE resampled data to reliably detect rare anomaly clusters while maintaining high precision.

projects.title: VisionX
projects.subtitle: Real-Time Object Detection System
projects.tagline: Computer vision pipeline rendering real-time bounding boxes and confidence scores.
projects.description: VisionX leverages OpenCV and deep neural networks (YOLO) to identify, track, and annotate multi-class objects across live camera feeds and video streams at high frame rates.
projects.problem: Object detection models often suffer from high frame drops and latency when deployed on commodity consumer hardware.
projects.solution: Optimized lightweight convolutional inference graphs with OpenCV DNN module, achieving smooth 30+ FPS real-time video processing.
